audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row read Irelia in both layers while the packet chart and the already-audited mirror (kassadin__irelia) both give that row to Kassadin.
audit.why: Kassadin's rank-3 Riftwalk is a 2s blink at 500 range; two items of AP plus that reset rate beats Irelia's reset pattern, and the mirror page already states Kassadin wins 2+ items. Earlier rows were left untouched on the mirror side, so they stay as they are here.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side and win[6] both flipped to Kassadin as an atomic pair. Levels 1-3 stay Irelia, Level 6 stays Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text described Level 3 and Level 6 without a single real cooldown number, so the advice was not actionable.
audit.why: Riftwalk's 5s rank-1 cooldown is the whole reason Level 6 is a coinflip rather than a loss, and Flawless Duet's stun is what buys the window back.
audit.corrected: Riftwalk's 5s (rank 1) and 2s (rank 3) cooldowns written into mid, late and whys[6]; spikes[0] now keys the Level 3 spike to the Null Sphere cancel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six strings claimed Null Sphere silences Irelia and cuts her Bladesurge resets. Riot's own description of Null Sphere has no silence — it deals damage, interrupts channels, and grants Kassadin a magic shield. The decisive real interaction, that Flawless Duet's stun cancels the Null Sphere cast, was never stated. Nether Blade's auto-attack reset (7s) was never named as the burst tell.
audit.why: A fabricated silence tells the player to hold their combo for a threat that does not exist, and hides the shield that actually flattens the back half of every trade. The kit's derived 'grounding' flag on Flawless Duet also contradicts Riot's text (damage, stun, Mark only) — treated as a tooltip-parsing misfire and not asserted.
audit.corrected: Silence claims removed from early, mid, late, whys[0], whys[6] and wants.foe[1] and replaced with the magic shield's real effect; the E-cancels-Null-Sphere interaction added to spikes[0] and mid; Nether Blade's auto reset added to wants.you[1] as the step-back tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Riftwalk can be denied by Vanguard's Edge terrain or by grounding was not addressable from the kits.
audit.why: Riot's text calls Riftwalk a teleport; terrain and grounding behaviour against blinks is not in the file and is not asserted anywhere in the rewrite.
audit.corrected: Left unstated. The late paragraph only says the wall covers his escape path, which is true of any wall.

edits.before: At level 1 you out-farm and out-pressure an escape-less Kassadin with Q (Bladesurge) resets, just respect his Null Sphere silence before you commit.
edits.after: At level 1 you out-farm and out-pressure an escape-less Kassadin with Q (Bladesurge) resets — Null Sphere does not silence, it chips and shields him.

edits.before: At 2+ items he out-scales hard — stacked Riftwalk plus a Null Sphere silence on your dash means he blinks, silences and bursts you before you can stick.
edits.after: At 2+ items he out-scales hard — a 2-second rank-3 Riftwalk plus full AP means he blinks out of Bladesurge range and bursts you before you can stick to him.

edits.before: E (Flawless Duet) comes online — place both blades, stun him between them, then Q (Bladesurge) onto him for a free reset. He has no blink until 6, so the stun is a guaranteed pin.
edits.after: E (Flawless Duet) comes online — the stun cancels a Null Sphere cast outright and pins him between the blades, then Q (Bladesurge) in for a free reset. He has no blink until 6, so it lands.

edits.before: Bait or eat his Null Sphere (Q) silence on a minion before you commit, so it can't cut your Q-reset chain mid all-in
edits.after: Watch the Nether Blade (W) wind-up, not the cast — that auto reset is the 7-second tell that his burst is starting

edits.before: Land Null Sphere (Q) at the start of every trade to silence your Bladesurge and deny the reset
edits.after: Land Null Sphere (Q) in every trade to chip you and bank the magic shield that eats your trade-back

edits.before: "Kassadin is a soft melee target levels 1-3 with no Riftwalk yet, so this is your pressure window. At level 1 just farm with Q (Bladesurge) resets off the wave and respect his Null Sphere (Q) — it deals magic damage and silences you, and a silenced Irelia can't chain Bladesurge resets. At level 3 your E (Flawless Duet) comes online: place the two blades, stun him between them, Q onto him for the reset, and weave autos while your Bladesurge stacks shred his resists. Try to bait his Q onto a minion first — if he silences you at the start of the trade your whole combo stalls."
edits.after: "Kassadin is a soft melee target levels 1-3 with no Riftwalk yet, so this is your pressure window. At level 1 just farm with Q (Bladesurge) resets off the wave and respect his Null Sphere (Q) — it chips you and banks a magic shield, and that shield eats the back half of your trade. At level 3 your E (Flawless Duet) comes online: place the two blades, stun him between them, Q onto him for the reset, and weave autos while your Bladesurge stacks shred his resists. Bait that Q onto the wave first on its 9s cooldown — shielded, he trades you even instead of losing."

edits.before: "Levels 4-6 you still have the edge on paper, but it tightens as he nears Riftwalk. Your Bladesurge passive is stacking and his only real defence is his passive magic-shield, so step up, E-stun, Q in and run him down before he farms to 6. Note your W (Defiant Dance) reduces mostly physical damage, so it is a weaker block against his magic burst than against an AD laner — use it to tank his Null Sphere, not to fully negate it. At 6 he gets Riftwalk to blink-kite your Q; the lane drifts toward a coinflip here, but with E up you can stun him mid-blink. This is your last clean window to bury him before his scaling takes over."
edits.after: "Levels 4-6 you still have the edge on paper, but it tightens as he nears Riftwalk. Your Bladesurge passive is stacking and his defences are a Null Sphere shield and 15% magic reduction, so step up, E-stun, Q in and run him down before he farms to 6. Note your W (Defiant Dance) reduces physical damage, so it is a weaker block against his magic burst than against an AD laner — use it to blunt Null Sphere, not to negate it. At 6 Riftwalk blink-kites your Q on a 5s cooldown; hold E, because the stun cancels his Null Sphere cast and pins him for the follow-up. This is your last clean window."

edits.before: "This lane flips the moment Kassadin reaches two items. With stacked Riftwalk and full AP he blinks in, silences your Bladesurge chain with Null Sphere so you can't reset, and bursts your bruiser HP before you stick to him — his passive magic-shield also eats your on-hit damage. Your only path is to have already snowballed: turn your levels 3-6 lead into plates, towers and objectives and end before he comes online. If the game goes long, group, let your team peel, and use Vanguard's Edge (R) to wall off his Riftwalk path in fights rather than trying to solo-duel a fed Kassadin — his blink and silence beat your reset pattern outright."
edits.after: "This lane flips the moment Kassadin reaches two items. With Riftwalk down to a 2-second cooldown and full AP he blinks in, bursts your bruiser HP before you stick to him, and blinks straight back out — his passive's magic reduction also blunts your Wit's End on-hit. Your only path is to have already snowballed: turn your levels 3-6 lead into plates, towers and objectives and end before he comes online. If the game goes long, group, let your team peel, and use Vanguard's Edge (R) to wall off his escape path in fights rather than trying to solo-duel a fed Kassadin — his blink range simply beats your reset pattern."

notes: Null Sphere has no silence in Riot's current text — six strings on this page were built on that fabricated silence and are corrected here. Flawless Duet's derived 'grounding' flag contradicts Riot's description (damage, stun, Mark only) and was treated as a tooltip-parsing misfire; nothing about grounding Riftwalk is asserted. Level chart row 6 flipped to Kassadin in both layers as a matched pair, matching the packet chart and the kassadin__irelia mirror; rows 0-5 left untouched because the mirror explicitly changed nothing earlier.
